jobs.title: Distributed Ledger Technology Product Manager - Assistant Vice President / Vice President
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About The Role

iCapital is seeking a highly motivated Product Manager to help oversee the development of our Distributed Ledger Technology platform. This individual will work within a team-oriented environment composed of dedicated professionals in a results-driven culture. This role offers opportunities for career growth and oversight of teams, projects, and departments. The selected candidate will address complex industry problems related to various Alternative Investment data workflows.

In collaboration with the Head of the Distributed Ledger Product this role aims to achieve scale and efficiency across diverse business processes and strategic initiatives firmwide. The position provides the opportunity to employ the latest technologies and innovative solutions. Responsibilities include leading and delivering industry solutions, overseeing data models, data validation, and data integrations, as well as identifying unmet needs, defining requirements, writing user stories, developing project communication plans, and testing implementations. The team operates through agile methodologies, with fast deployment and iterative improvements being core principles. We value collaboration and a multi-disciplinary approach in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities

- Lead product efforts for new business initiatives from ideation through phases of delivery and timely execution.

- Develop the strategic roadmap and lead the direction of the product data models and APIs in partnership with stakeholders.

- Present, communicate, and work directly with executive management as needed and provide status updates on critical strategic implementations.

- Resolve issues and concerns regarding resource allocation and work with stakeholders to manage expectations and set priorities.

- Mentor the team by coaching and leading by example in all aspects of development, whether building relationships or project execution.

- Develop a strong understanding of business impacts and manage concurrent requests and requirements.

- Manage client integrations and oversee team execution to ensure flawless implementation.

- Work with engineering leads to ensure the performance of APIs and connectivity with clients meets high standards throughout the product lifecycle.

- Maintain awareness of the competitive landscape from business, legal, and compliance perspectives.

- Contribute to the team and overall company mission beyond the product realm when appropriate.

Qualifications

- 6-10+ years of experience in Product Management in a fast-paced, agile environment.

- Exceptionally strong organizational and communication skills are required.

- Finance/Fintech experience is preferred, especially in Alternative Investments.

- Proven track record of managing technical teams and strategic initiatives.

- Demonstrated influence in partnerships with colleagues, teams, and clients.

- Excellent communicator, comfortable engaging with executive management for ideas and resolutions.

- Strong technical background and understanding; ability to design and implement strategic API functionalities at scale.

- Natural problem solver driven to push initiatives to conclusions.

- Critical thinker comfortable with the unknown.

- Willingness to dig deep, analyze, and understand how things work.

- Data analysis experience required, with an emphasis on SQL and developing API integrations.

- Strong interpersonal skills capable of building relationships to gain buy-in and achieve business results.

- History of customer-centric focus with quick and thoughtful problem-solving abilities.

- Experience in data engineering and quantitative science is preferred, but not required.

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 to $200,000 depending on level  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Analyst / Associate
jobs.location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is seeking an Analyst or Associate responsible for supporting the Product Managers with all aspects of the successful operations of the funds in the Independent Advisor Solutions Business (IAS). The IAS business line is a rapidly growing platform of registered evergreen funds.

Responsibilities

- Support the management and maintenance of product-related data, reporting, and marketing content across multiple investment products and distribution channels.

- Partner with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to develop and implement workflow optimization tools and AI-driven capabilities.

- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, artificial intelligence, and technology-enabled solutions.

- Conduct market, industry, and competitor research to support product strategy, positioning, and business development initiatives.

- Develop dashboards, analyses, and reporting solutions that provide actionable insights for product, investment, and sales teams.

- Support ongoing product monitoring and operational activities, including portfolio reporting, regulatory and tax-related oversight, and investor activity tracking.

- Coordinate with external partners, service providers, and sub-advisers to facilitate information sharing and marketing initiatives.

- Assist with due diligence requests, RFPs, questionnaires, and onboarding documentation for platforms and distribution partners.

- Contribute to ad hoc analyses, strategic projects, and special initiatives as business needs evolve.

- Document key meetings, track action items, and support follow-up activities to ensure timely execution of projects and initiatives.

Qualifications

- 1-5 years of relevant experience in financial services (i.e. private equity, investment banking, capital markets, transaction advisory services, investment consulting, portfolio analytics, etc.)

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Demonstrates a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail

- Able to problem-solve and make logical business recommendations in a fast-paced environment

- Professional demeanor with an entrepreneurial attitude and a strong sense of ownership

- Exhibits a positive, growth-oriented mindset and takes on new challenges and responsibilities, consistently contributing beyond core responsibilities

Benefits

Analyst

The compensation range for this role at the Analyst level is $60,000 to $70,000 annually. This position is paid on an hourly basis and is classified as non-exempt. Employees in this role are eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable law.

Associate

The base salary range for this role at the Associate level is $75,000 to $90,000 annually. This position is salaried and classified as exempt.

Both Levels

iCapital offers a compensation package that includes equity for all full-time employees and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer-matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer-paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Evergreen Private Fund Solutions - Assistant Vice President / Vice President
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the Role

The market for alternative investments is undergoing a significant transformation, and iCapital is at the forefront, building the technology and service models that connect General Partners (GPs) with the high-net-worth market. We are launching a new, dedicated line of business to provide a comprehensive, end-to-end solution for a sophisticated and rapidly growing fund structure: the '34 Act Registered Fund.

iCapital is seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Manager to serve as the central point of ownership for these funds. This is a critical, high-visibility role that will act as the primary point of contact for all operational aspects of a GP's '34 Act fund(s). This individual will partner closely with the GP's dedicated Relationship Manager to ensure a seamless client experience, with the RM managing the overall firm relationship and you owning the product-specific lifecycle.

Responsibilities

- Co-manage the fund launch project plan for new clients in close partnership with the Fund Origination team, ensuring all milestones across structuring, documentation, operational readiness, and launch are met on time.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all operational, administrative, and technical aspects of the GP's '34 Act fund(s).

- Work in tandem with the GP's Relationship Manager to provide coordinated and comprehensive service experience.

- Act as the primary liaison between the GP and all internal iCapital teams, including Fund Finance, Investor Relations, Legal, Compliance, Tax, and Technology, to manage ongoing fund operations.

- Act as a key coordinator between the GP client and their distribution partners (wealth management firms) which includes working with the Investor Relations team and iCapital Wealth Management RM covering the distributor to ensure operational readiness, resolve inquiries, and facilitate a smooth flow of information on behalf of the GP.

- Coordinate the internal review of all fund documents (PPM, LPA, Form 10) to ensure operational feasibility.

- Oversee the configuration of the fund on the iCapital platform, including share classes, fee structures, and reporting requirements.

- Lead the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process with internal teams to validate all platform workflows before launch.

- Provide clients with valuable market intelligence on '34 Act fund trends and structural best practices.

- Maintain a risk and issue log for each fund launch and contribute to the ongoing improvement of our operational playbooks.

Qualifications

- 5 - 9+ years of experience in product management, project management, or a client-facing fund operations role within the financial services industry.

- Deep understanding of alternative investment products and fund structures is required. Direct experience with registered funds (e.g., interval funds, tender offer funds, BDCs) or private funds with complex operational requirements is highly preferred

- Familiar with software and technology platforms used across the alternative investments, wealth management, and fund services landscape

- Able to develop an intimate understanding of the iCapital system and its relation to the broader ecosystem of administrators, custodians, and transfer agents

- Familiar with the Investment Company Act of 1940 and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, including an understanding of periodic SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), is a significant plus

- Proven ability to manage sophisticated institutional client relationships, with exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

- Track record of successfully managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects from inception to completion. Detail-oriented, highly organized, and adept at managing competing priorities

- Team player with a demonstrated ability to navigate a complex ecosystem and work effectively across different internal functional teams and external client relationships (GP, Distribution Partner) to achieve a common goal

- Direct experience in an investor services or investor relations role at a General Partner (GP) or alternative investment fund

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 to $180,000. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

For additional information on iCapital, please visit  https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
